experiment: Experiment 3: parameter-efficient fine-tuning of OmniAID v2's low-rank experts
method: official OmniAID main_finetune.py route (--model OmniAID --pretrained_checkpoint, training_mode=standard); official create_model_and_ema, create_optimizer_criterion_scaler, create_dataloaders and engine_finetune.train_one_epoch. Project wrapper replaces only the outer epoch loop: validation-only scoring each epoch, and saving of adapted parameters instead of full 3 GB checkpoints.

training.scheduler: official half-cycle cosine per iteration (utils.adjust_learning_rate), no warmup
training.loss: official get_losses: label-smoothed CE (0.1) + 0.001*orthogonality + 0.001*router balance (+ gating CE, inactive)
training.sampler: official DistributedSampler(shuffle=True, seed=0); set_epoch(epoch) called each epoch as in the official multi-GPU run

value_sources.Verified-v2: read from args stored inside the official v2 checkpoint
PROJECT: batch_size=4 (batch 8 ran out of T4 memory in the Stage 10 probe)

frozen_modules: buffers: main attention weights, SVD bases
preprocessing: Resize(336,336) + ToTensor + CLIP mean/std (official v2 single-resize pipeline; identical to baseline); no augmentation
checkpoint_selection_rule: VALIDATION only: highest balanced accuracy at each epoch's own Youden threshold; if |difference| < 0.001 prefer higher validation fake recall; if still tied, earlier epoch
threshold_selection_rule: Youden's J on VALIDATION scores of the selected (reloaded) model; frozen before TEST
test_policy: TEST never copied locally, never used for any decision; evaluated once after freezing
